NSW police say suicide note and ‘other evidence’ suggest six-year-old’s death was an act of domestic violence Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A suicide note has been located after the bodies of a young girl and her father were pulled from the Parramatta River on Saturday. The six-year-old may have been deliberately thrown in the water by the man from a hired boat in what police believe was a horrific act of domestic violence. “We have uncovered a suicide note and some other evidence drawing us to this conclusion,” NSW police marine area commander, Supt Joe McNulty, told 2GB radio on Monday.

Police have revealed disturbing new details about the drowning deaths of a six-year-old girl and her father in Sydney’s inner west, saying the 47-year-old man had planned and rehearsed the murder-suicide. An empty boat was found drifting slowly across the Parramatta River on Saturday, after the father deliberately threw his young daughter overboard before jumping in himself. Neither could swim. Know the news with the 7NEWS app: Download today WATCH THE VIDEO ABOVE: Father drowns daughter in planned Parramatta River murder-suicide Detectives discovered a note on board the vessel, confirming their suspicions that the tragedy was premeditated. Investigators have since learned it was the third time in a week the man had hired a runabout from the Cabarita Point Marina.

The father and daughter arrived at the marina in an Uber at 10am on Saturday. Just before midday, boaties discovered the man’s body floating in the water. Divers recovered the little girl’s body at dusk. “This is an absolute tragedy for the family and the community on every level,” Burwood Police Area Command Superintendent Christine McDonald said. While concerns about the father’s state of mind have since emerged, police say they received no formal reports of family or domestic violence. “It’s up to everyone to speak up if something seems wrong,” federal domestic, family and sexual violence commissioner Micaela Cronin said. “Watching for behaviours that you are concerned about and asking: ‘are you OK’?” “Unfortunately, it’s not uncommon for there to be people who are struggling in silence.”

original_article.research:
[Lähde: The Guardian World]
NSW police say suicide note and ‘other evidence’ suggest six-year-old’s death was an act of domestic violence

Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates

Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

A suicide note has been located after the bodies of a young girl and her father were pulled from the Parramatta River on Saturday.

The six-year-old may have been deliberately thrown in the water by the man from a hired boat in what police believe was a horrific act of domestic violence.

“We have uncovered a suicide note and some other evidence drawing us to this conclusion,” NSW police marine area commander, Supt Joe McNulty, told 2GB radio on Monday.

Officers were called to Hen and Chicken Bay at Concord, in Sydney’s inner west, at about 11.45am after reports of a man’s body floating in the water.

A boat owned by a member of the public was used by police to retrieve the 47-year-old, but he was unable to be revived.

Reports that a young girl had also been present prompted a widespread search which lasted several hours before her body was also recovered from the water.

Police used CCTV images of the incident from a nearby home to help divers locate the girl’s body.

The man was not known to police and had no recorded history of domestic violence, leaving police with the difficult job of unravelling what occurred.

“We really need to make sense of this, because it is a complex investigation,” McNulty said.

McNulty said officers were immediately suspicious as to the circumstances of the incident because lifejackets were on board the boat but had not been used.

The girl’s mother was notified and present during the search for her daughter.

“At this stage it’s horrible, but we’re wrapping so much care around the victim and the mother that’s been left behind,” McNulty said.

The girl is the couple’s only child, Supt Christine McDonald from Burwood police command told media on Saturday.

“Obviously, a mother in this situation … it would rock any mother to the core,” she said.

A friend of the man had contacted police an hour after his body was located with concerns for the father and daughter’s welfare, police said.

---

[Lähde: 7NEWS Australia]
Police have revealed disturbing new details about the drowning deaths of a six-year-old girl and her father in Sydney’s inner west, saying the 47-year-old man had planned and rehearsed the murder-suicide.

An empty boat was found drifting slowly across the Parramatta River on Saturday, after the father deliberately threw his young daughter overboard before jumping in himself. Neither could swim.

Know the news with the 7NEWS app: Download today

WATCH THE VIDEO ABOVE: Father drowns daughter in planned Parramatta River murder-suicide

Detectives discovered a note on board the vessel, confirming their suspicions that the tragedy was premeditated.

Investigators have since learned it was the third time in a week the man had hired a runabout from the Cabarita Point Marina.

The father and daughter arrived at the marina in an Uber at 10am on Saturday. Just before midday, boaties discovered the man’s body floating in the water.

Divers recovered the little girl’s body at dusk.

“This is an absolute tragedy for the family and the community on every level,” Burwood Police Area Command Superintendent Christine McDonald said.

While concerns about the father’s state of mind have since emerged, police say they received no formal reports of family or domestic violence.

“It’s up to everyone to speak up if something seems wrong,” federal domestic, family and sexual violence commissioner Micaela Cronin said. “Watching for behaviours that you are concerned about and asking: ‘are you OK’?”

“Unfortunately, it’s not uncommon for there to be people who are struggling in silence.”

payload.title: Poliisi tutkii kuusivuotiaan kuolemaa Sydneyssä epäiltynä murha-itsemurhana
payload.summary: Uuden Etelä-Walesin poliisi tutkii kuusivuotiaan tytön ja hänen 47-vuotiaan isänsä hukkumiskuolemia epäiltynä perheväkivaltaan liittyvänä murha-itsemurhana Parramatta-joella Sydneyssä.
payload.content:
Australiassa Uuden Etelä-Walesin poliisi tutkii kuusivuotiaan tytön ja hänen 47-vuotiaan isänsä kuolemia epäiltynä murha-itsemurhana Sydneyssä. Poliisin mukaan itsemurhaviesti ja muu näyttö viittaavat siihen, että lapsi olisi heitetty veteen vuokratusta veneestä Parramatta-joella lauantaina.

## Vene löytyi ajelehtimasta joella

Poliisin mukaan tyttö ja hänen isänsä saapuivat Cabarita Pointin venesatamaan Uberilla lauantaina kello 10. He olivat vuokranneet pienen moottoriveneen. Myöhemmin joelta löytyi tyhjä vene, joka ajelehti hitaasti Parramatta-joella.

Viranomaisten mukaan isän ruumis löydettiin vedestä hieman ennen puoltapäivää. Sukeltajat löysivät tytön ruumiin illan hämärtyessä. Poliisi on kertonut, ettei kumpikaan osannut uida.

Tutkijat ovat selvittäneet, että mies oli vuokrannut samanlaisen veneen Cabarita Pointin satamasta kolmesti viikon aikana. Poliisin mukaan tämä sekä veneestä löytynyt viesti tukevat epäilyä siitä, että teko oli suunniteltu etukäteen.

## Poliisi löysi viestin veneestä

Uuden Etelä-Walesin poliisin merialueen komentaja Joe McNulty sanoi maanantaina, että poliisi oli löytänyt itsemurhaviestin sekä muuta näyttöä, joka johti tutkijoita tähän johtopäätökseen. Poliisi pitää kuolemantapauksia perheväkivaltaan liittyvänä tekona.

Burwoodin poliisialueen ylikomisario Christine McDonald kuvasi tapahtunutta tragediaksi perheelle ja koko yhteisölle. Poliisin mukaan isän mielentilasta oli jälkikäteen noussut esiin huolia, mutta viranomaiset eivät olleet saaneet aiemmin virallisia ilmoituksia perhe- tai lähisuhdeväkivallasta.

## Komissaari kehotti puuttumaan huoliin

Australian perhe-, lähisuhde- ja seksuaaliväkivallan komissaari Micaela Cronin kehotti ihmisiä reagoimaan tilanteisiin, joissa jokin vaikuttaa olevan vialla. Hänen mukaansa on tärkeää kysyä huolta herättävältä ihmiseltä, onko tämä kunnossa, sillä osa ihmisistä kamppailee ongelmien kanssa hiljaisuudessa.
summary_bullets: Kuusivuotias tyttö ja hänen 47-vuotias isänsä löydettiin kuolleina Parramatta-joesta Sydneyssä.
Poliisin mukaan viesti ja muu näyttö viittaavat epäiltyyn perheväkivaltaan liittyvään murha-itsemurhaan.
Tutkijat selvittivät, että mies oli vuokrannut veneen samasta satamasta kolmesti viikon aikana.
